import_settings._note: Godot 4 has no per-texture sRGB switch: StandardMaterial3D samples albedo/emission as sRGB and normal/ORM/roughness/AO as linear. What import controls is compression, the normal-map flag (RG compression, linear) and mipmaps, so 'sRGB for albedo only' is met by assigning each map to its correct material slot, which the glTF already does.
